careUse.direction: board of residence to board of treatment
careUse.missingCellMeaning: Unpublished cells remain unknown, not zero. Any nonnumeric/suppressed cell rejects refresh.
careUse.boundaryMethod: Compare paired HBR and HBT codes directly. Raw source flag is retained for audit; its dictionary wording contradicts the currently published values.
careUse.limitations: Repeated stays, not unique patients or interhospital transfers. Special provider codes retain source identities. Published counts may be disclosure-controlled; this is a reported numeric-stay share, not all care need or current capacity.
